pages.text: Parts are held in optical and magnetic traps of stiffness κ. Equipartition sets the jitter: σ = √(kT/κ). To place parts to a picometre you need a stiff trap and a cold one - but light heats the trap and ultraviolet damages the parts.
$(thing)Set$(): Trap laser power, Wavelength, Tweezer field.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Laser pointing noise: stiffness varies by ±3%·d.

$(thing)Limits$(): Photodamage: the light is breaking the parts; Interlock: magnetic-tweezer coils not superconducting (too warm); Field above the critical field: the magnetic-tweezer coils quench.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): A stiffer trap settles faster.

$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Trap stiffness κ: κ ∝ P/λ³ + B²$(br)Trap temperature: T_trap = T + absorbed light$(br)Placement jitter σ: σ = √(kT/κ)$(br)Photodamage index: ∝ P/λ³$(br)Critical field: B_c(T) = B_c2(0)·(1 − (T/T_c)²)
